analysis.rootCauseHypothesis:
The hosting side is likely serving 访谈记录 through the same UI template used for a document/file library, which automatically injects the search field and toolbar controls. In other words, the directory is being treated as a standard browseable collection with actions enabled, instead of a folder-only view. The parent-folder breadcrumb/back navigation is correct, so the failure appears to be limited to the per-directory view configuration or conditional rendering logic for toolbar visibility. Underlying error: TEST FAILURE

The 访谈记录 directory showed a search field and toolbar controls, although the test requires that toolbar region to be absent. The parent-folder check passed: after returning once, the heading showed 研究资料 with 访谈记录 as a child, and no misleading empty-directory prompt was visible.

Observations:
- 访谈记录 showed 21 files and a search field with toolbar controls.
- After returning once, 研究资料 and its 访谈记录 child were visible.
- No misleading prompt claiming the folder-only directory was empty was visible.

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Adjust the folder-view UI so that when the current directory is 访谈记录, the page renders it as a plain folder listing without the search bar and toolbar region. If those controls are globally mounted by the layout, gate them behind a file-listing mode check or a permission/state flag so they are hidden for this directory. Also verify the route/data source for 访谈记录 isn’t incorrectly classified as a searchable document library view, and ensure the directory’s metadata does not opt it into the toolbar-enabled template.
